name: Charges 5
definition: Charges related to a payment obligation contracted between two financial institutions related to the financing of a commercial transaction.

ChargesPayer.name: Charges Payer
ChargesPayer.definition: Bank which will pay the charges.

ChargesPayee.name: Charges Payee
ChargesPayee.definition: Bank which will receive the charges.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of the charges taken by the payer.

Percentage.name: Percentage
Percentage.definition: Amount of the charges expressed as a percentage of the amount paid by the obligor bank.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of charges. For example: transaction charges, financing charges, deferred payment, interests.
